title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
lineage: Dolby B metal cassette master > 20-bit SBM2 > CDR (David Gans master) > EAC > SoundForge
source: Set 1 SBD > Dolby B metal cassette master. Set 2  SBD > ? (likely cassette master)

ai_review.summary: Rich sound‑board recording of a solid early‑’80 show highlighted by a powerful Morning Dew and memorable Spanish Jam.
ai_review.review: The post‑April ’82 SBD captures the band with clear, ambient mix and a surprisingly full bass that many early‑‘80 tapes lack. The performance is consistently good – Jerry, Brent and Bob are praised throughout while Phil receives mixed remarks, and the set’s standout moments include Morning Dew and the tense Spanish Jam/Other One transition.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is solid with several praised songs and decent energy, while recording quality is notably good; mixed comments on Phil keep the overall rating just below four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, rich and ambient mix with full bass; no major drop‑outs or muffling noted. Reviewers describe it as a very good SBD for the period.

standout_songs: Spanish Jam (tension into The Other One)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently solid throughout; no single section dominates, though a noticeable tension during the Spanish Jam/Other One transition is highlighted.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as great throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mixed feedback – one reviewer felt Phil was off‑night, another praised his authority and presence in the mix.
band_member_comments.Bob: Praised overall; noted for keeping the Spanish Jam going despite tension with Phil.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keys) is highlighted as great throughout.
